recipe.text: Distinct concept: a LEFT-RAIL menu (vs the existing centered panel variant) - dark Gotham palette, full-screen gradient vignette darker over the rail side, 340px rail with UIListLayout/UIPadding, GothamBlack title + orange keyline, buttons with colored left accent bars and key hints, UICorner/UIStroke throughout.
